summary: End-to-end test of new analyze -> edit -> press flow for Fisher-Price Record Maker. Backend: 13/13 new pytest tests pass in test_analyze_press.py covering /api/analyze shape (16x86 bool partition, offset/exact/adjusted/merged/notes_used/duration/start/beats=86), 422 for empty window (start=25) and 400 for non-MIDI, /api/press summary (single + two-sided), 400 for wrong-shape (15 rows) and empty partition, STL binary >100KB, SCAD contains 'glyph(' and 'twoSided = true/false' + ',true)' pins, FPR 16 rows of +/- + title, side=b returns 404 for single-sided and 200 for two-sided, legacy /api/convert still includes partition, list endpoint has no leaks. Frontend: Upload hidden input + title autofill ('sample_twinkle') -> LOAD NOTES analyze -> editor-workspace with 28-29 notes (one more than spec's 28). Add/remove/reset note interactions work; play-button toggles STOP + playhead renders; rev-slider updates rev-value and speed-readout (32s/rev at 25s window = 78% tempo); duration=32 with rev=25 shows window-speed '128% tempo' and match-speed-button appears -> clicking sets duration back to 25. Stale badge appears after duration change and clears after re-analyze. Two-sided: toggle reveals side-mode-file/continue + title-b-input. Continue mode shows notice-panel + side-tab-a/b; side B grid starts blank-ish and allows adding notes. File mode exposes midi-upload-zone-b-input and requires a second file. CUT THE RECORD renders 3D canvas, result-panel 'A + B' for two-sided, all four download buttons (stl/scad/fpr/fpr-b) present with /api/conversions/{id}/{...} hrefs. Tab-notes / tab-preview switching works. Recent pressings history loads and clicking history-preview-{id} rehydrates viewer.
critical_code_review_comments: Note count displayed in editor after analyze was 29 while review request expected exactly 28 for sample_twinkle.mid first 25s. Likely an off-by-one between MIDI note_on events and quantized grid cells (duplicate at same tone+beat gets counted as merged in backend but still rendered). Not a bug, just a spec mismatch worth confirming.

Side B in 'continue' mode started with 1 pre-existing note instead of a fully empty 16x86 grid as described in agent-context note. Could be the continue-mode seeder; worth checking initial Side B partition state in Creator.js.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context.

STL base64 blobs stored directly in Mongo document (potentially 100KB-1MB per record) will approach the 16MB BSON limit for long titles / dense partitions. GridFS or filesystem would be safer long-term.
No MAX_UPLOAD check on /api/press payload size (JSON partition is small, but partition_b doubles it).
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_* conversions in Mongo via /api/press during testing (TEST_PressA, TEST_SideA/TEST_SideB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_analyze_press.py; legacy tests in test_fisher_price_api.py. The sample_twinkle.mid produces ~28 note-on events in first 25s but renders 29 unique partition cells (minor discrepancy). HEAD/GET of download URLs from python urllib returns 403 due to ingress UA filter -- use `requests` library instead (confirmed working in backend tests).
